usedFor: Way We Do runs checklists, and Calendly creates a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link” after “Checklist Finished”.

bestTemplate.name: “Checklist Finished” in Way We Do, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A finished checklist produces a booking link, so the next meeting is one click away.

watchOut: “Create Scheduling Link” runs on each trigger, so “Checklist Step Completed” would make a link per step.
